title: Punta Arenas -> Panama (to Costa Rica border approach)

waypoints.name: Punta Arenas, Chile
waypoints.event: Expedition start. Arrived by air via Falklands on night of 31 Oct; assembled trailer ('the beast') and moved ~20 yards before wheel/axle failure (night 31 Oct/1 Nov, 'Day one'). Site and press releases give 1 Nov 1998 as start date; real walking began Mon 2 Nov 1998 at 10:36 after repairs (see conflicts).

waypoints.name: Night stop 2 Nov 1998 (journal grid; longitude suspect)
waypoints.event: Day 1 walking, 10 miles; camp on cliff overlooking Strait of Magellan. Reported grid 52°59'S 71°50'W lies west of Punta Arenas - longitude probably a slip (70°50'?); not used for routing.

waypoints.name: Night stop 3 Nov 1998 (journal grid)
waypoints.event: 20.5 miles; passed an estuary.

waypoints.name: Wrong turn onto dirt track, 4-5 Nov 1998 (position unknown)
waypoints.event: Took a dirt track north by mistake ('Grid : ----- not sure!'), walked back south-east; regained the paved road on 6 Nov. Coordinates are a rough placeholder only.

waypoints.name: Night stop 6 Nov 1998 near oil refinery junction (journal grid)
waypoints.event: Back on the 'metal road'; told 'there is only one road to Argentina and I'm on it'.

waypoints.name: Night stop 7 Nov 1998 (journal grid)
waypoints.event: Passed a ghost town with two trawlers rusting by the jetty (consistent with San Gregorio - identification is our inference, unnamed in journal).

waypoints.name: Night stop 8 Nov 1998 (journal grid)
waypoints.event: 22 miles.

waypoints.name: Chile -> Argentina border crossing (post unnamed; consistent with Monte Aymond / Integracion Austral)
waypoints.event: Crossed Chilean then Argentine checkpoint ~13:30. Journal does not name the post; night grid that day 52°00'S 69°31'W. Identification as Monte Aymond is inference from the 'only one road to Argentina' and grid.

waypoints.name: Night stop 10 Nov 1998 (journal grid)
waypoints.event: '15 miles to Rio Gallegos'.

waypoints.name: Rio Gallegos, Argentina
waypoints.event: Arrived with broken wheel spindle; rest days 12-14 Nov. Left 15 Nov crossing the river Gallegos and turning north.

waypoints.name: Night stop 17 Nov 1998 (journal grid)
waypoints.event: 29 miles.

waypoints.name: Night stop 19 Nov 1998 (journal grid)
waypoints.event: 28 miles.

waypoints.name: Comandante Luis Piedra Buena, Argentina
waypoints.event: Arrived 20 Nov; rest days 21-26 Nov (injured toe, school talk). Left 27 Nov.

waypoints.name: Night stop 1998-11-27 (journal grid)
waypoints.event: Dirt road Piedra Buena -> Gobernador Gregores (road number not given in journal).

waypoints.name: Night stop 1998-11-30 (journal grid)
waypoints.event: Dirt road Piedra Buena -> Gobernador Gregores (road number not given in journal).

waypoints.name: Night stop 1998-12-01 (journal grid)
waypoints.event: Dirt road Piedra Buena -> Gobernador Gregores (road number not given in journal).

waypoints.name: Night stop 1998-12-02 (journal grid)
waypoints.event: Dirt road Piedra Buena -> Gobernador Gregores (road number not given in journal).

waypoints.name: Night stop 1998-12-03 (journal grid)
waypoints.event: Dirt road Piedra Buena -> Gobernador Gregores (road number not given in journal).

waypoints.name: Gobernador Gregores, Argentina
waypoints.event: Arrived 4 Dec (journal grid 48°45'S 70°15'W); rest/repair 5-8 Dec; left 9 Dec. Decided not to go to San Julian.

waypoints.name: Night stop 1998-12-11 (journal grid)
waypoints.event: Reached junction: 'now on route 40'.

waypoints.name: Bajo Caracoles, Argentina
waypoints.event: Passed ('Before I left B.C') on Ruta 40; night grid 18 Dec 47°16'S 70°57'W. Exact arrival date in Bajo Caracoles not stated (17 or 18 Dec).

waypoints.name: Night stop 20 Dec 1998 (journal grid)
waypoints.event: Journal grid for 21 Dec reads '41 degrees 44' - evident typo, omitted.

waypoints.name: Perito Moreno, Argentina
waypoints.event: Arrived 22 Dec (journal grid 46°36'S 70°55'W) with second broken spindle; Christmas/New Year stay; satellite phone problems; left Mon 4 Jan 1999 ~16:00.

waypoints.name: Night stop 4 Jan 1999 (journal grid)
waypoints.event: Junction where the paved road meets 'the track that is route 40 north'.

waypoints.name: Night stop 8 Jan 1999 (journal grid)
waypoints.event: 10 km short of Rio Mayo.

waypoints.name: Rio Mayo, Argentina
waypoints.event: Arrived 9 Jan (grid 45°41'S 70°16'W); stayed with Gabriel (English teacher) until 20 Jan; realised 90-day visa nearly expired.

waypoints.name: Gobernador Costa, Argentina
waypoints.event: 'Gord Costa' reached 28 Jan (grid 44°05'S 70°30'W); stayed to 31 Jan.

waypoints.name: Night stop 1 Feb 1999 (journal grid)
waypoints.event: Snow overnight.

waypoints.name: Tecka, Argentina
waypoints.event: Reached 15:00 (grid 43°30'S 70°49'W); cut wrist badly with knife repairing trailer.

waypoints.name: Junction where Karl left the main road for Esquel (location not given)
waypoints.event: Karl walked off the main road down to Esquel; on 22 Feb he was driven back to this junction (offroute) and resumed walking from it. Exact junction not identified - placeholder coordinates.

waypoints.name: Esquel, Argentina
waypoints.event: Arrived 17:30, 5 Feb; stayed on architect William's building site until 22 Feb, out of money waiting for mail from home (money arrived 16 Feb). 7 Feb visa run by vehicle via Trevelin to a frontier post and back (offroute).

waypoints.name: El Hoyo, Argentina
waypoints.event: Journal heading 'El Hovo'.

waypoints.name: El Bolson, Argentina
waypoints.event: Arrived during national festival; left 28 Feb.

waypoints.name: San Carlos de Bariloche, Argentina
waypoints.event: Arrived 4 Mar; admin days; left 7 Mar.

waypoints.name: Villa La Angostura, Argentina
waypoints.event: Passed through at end of day 10 Mar.

waypoints.name: Argentina -> Chile border on Andean pass (pass unnamed; consistent with Paso Cardenal Samore)
waypoints.event: Argentine post 11 Mar; reached 'WELCOME TO CHILE' sign at pass 12 Mar; Chilean checkpoint 22 km downhill. Pass name not in journal - Samore is inference from route Villa La Angostura -> Entre Lagos -> Osorno.

waypoints.name: Entre Lagos, Chile
waypoints.event: Journal: "a small town called 'Entrelagos'".

waypoints.name: Osorno, Chile
waypoints.event: 'Total distance to date = approx 1370 miles.' Joined Route 5 / Pan-American north.

waypoints.name: Los Lagos, Chile
waypoints.event: Out of money ('I was now broke!').

waypoints.name: Temuco, Chile
waypoints.event: Waited for mail/money 5-7 Apr.

waypoints.name: Chillan, Chile
waypoints.event: Journal spells 'Chilean'; stayed with locals ~22-26 Apr.

waypoints.name: Rancagua, Chile
waypoints.event: Waited for money/mail 9-10 May.

waypoints.name: Santiago, Chile
waypoints.event: Arrived 12 May on 'Pan American Route 5'; ~2-week stay; left via Av. Americo Vespucio onto Route 5 north, departure between 28 and 31 May (not dated).

waypoints.name: Position 1 Jun 1999 north of Santiago (journal grid)
El Melon, Chile
waypoints.event: Girlfriend 'Treiz' walked 15 km with him 5-6 Jun, then bus back to Santiago.

waypoints.name: Los Vilos, Chile
waypoints.event: Stayed 10-14 Jun with taxi driver Sergio Romero Avila.

waypoints.name: Coquimbo / La Serena, Chile
waypoints.event: Stay ~22 Jun-10 Jul (coords = Coquimbo).

waypoints.name: Vallenar, Chile
waypoints.event: Stayed ~16-28 Jul with Marcela's family.

waypoints.name: Copiapo, Chile
waypoints.event: Visa overstay resolved by paying US$100; money wired from home; left 9 Aug.

waypoints.name: Balneario Flamenco, Chile
waypoints.event: Road sign 'Chanaral 30 kms'.

waypoints.name: Antofagasta, Chile
waypoints.event: 'Distance to date = 2740 mls (approx).' Left Route 5 at La Negra and walked west down to the coast. Departure date unknown (journal pages for 31 Aug-14 Sep missing).

waypoints.name: Tropic of Capricorn crossing (journal grid; latitude suspect)
waypoints.event: 'Today I crossed the Tropic of Capricorn' - but reported 23°50'S is south of Antofagasta; the Tropic (23°26'S) lies north of it. Grid probably garbled.

waypoints.name: Mejillones area (passed 18 km to west), Chile
waypoints.event: Coast road north; road number not given.

waypoints.name: Tocopilla, Chile
waypoints.event: Stay of several days ~22-26 Sep.

waypoints.name: Iquique, Chile
waypoints.event: Arrived on journal date 'Friday, 31st September' (impossible; probably 1 Oct). 'Distance to date = 3080 mls (approx)'. Stayed to 20 Oct.

waypoints.name: Arica, Chile
waypoints.event: Arrived 29 Oct (journal grid). Stayed to 15 Nov incl. offroute trips (bus to Tocopilla; visa run to border/Tacna).

waypoints.name: Chile -> Peru border on Pan-American, position after crossing (journal grid; post unnamed - Chacalluta/Santa Rosa by inference)
waypoints.event: Walked across ~13:00; Chilean side normally forbids pedestrians but allowed him.

waypoints.name: Tacna, Peru
waypoints.event: Wheel spindle broke on ring-road roundabout.

waypoints.name: Moquegua, Peru
waypoints.event: 5 km detour off Pan-American into town; rest 23-26 Nov, back to Pan-American.

waypoints.name: Arequipa, Peru
waypoints.event: Walked in deliberately although 'well off my route'; ~1-month stay (money, Christmas) to 4 Jan 2000.

waypoints.name: Uchumayo, Peru
waypoints.event: Walked ~19 km out of Arequipa, then truck lift to Pan-American junction (offroute).

waypoints.name: Pan-American junction (probably La Reparticion - inference)
waypoints.event: Dropped by truck 18:30; unclear whether same junction where he left the Pan-American on 1 Dec.

waypoints.name: Ica, Peru
waypoints.event: ~12-day rest, waiting for Western Union money; ill; left 7 Feb.

waypoints.name: Chincha, Peru
waypoints.event: Visa expired ~11 Feb.

waypoints.name: Lima, Peru
waypoints.event: Entered via beach road, lodged in Rimac; attempted robbery. Visa stay 17 Feb-8 Mar; got only 7-day extension and carried on without visa.

waypoints.name: Chimbote, Peru
waypoints.event: Rest 21-27 Mar (money/mail).

waypoints.name: Trujillo, Peru
waypoints.event: Rest 2-7 Apr with host Roberto.

waypoints.name: Chiclayo, Peru
waypoints.event: ~17-day stop (anaemia diagnosed; Holy-week trip to Trujillo by truck/bus, offroute).

waypoints.name: Piura, Peru
waypoints.event: Waited for money 10-16 May.

waypoints.name: Sullana, Peru
waypoints.event: ~17-25 May; bought a donkey and stopped using the trailer.

waypoints.name: Las Lomas, Peru
waypoints.event: Inland detour (146 km) to avoid border police - no valid visa.

waypoints.name: Jilili, Peru
waypoints.event: Last Peru grid 2 Jun: 04°33'S 79°48'W, 'a day away from the border'.

waypoints.name: Peru -> Ecuador unofficial river crossing ('River Caiuas', probably Rio Calvas - inference)
waypoints.event: Crossed away from any border post with pack horse; reported grid "70 degrees 50 minutes west, 04 degrees 27 minutes south. ( approx )" - longitude evidently means 79°50'W.

waypoints.name: Cariamanga, Ecuador
waypoints.event: Sold lame horse; sent kit ahead by bus to Loja.

waypoints.name: Loja, Ecuador
waypoints.event: Stay 10-25 Jun incl. offroute bus visa run to Macara.

waypoints.name: Cuenca, Ecuador
waypoints.event: 'Distance to date:- 5010 miles approx.' Rest to 10 Jul.

waypoints.name: Riobamba, Ecuador
waypoints.event: Notes for 10-22 Jul reconstructed from memory (originals stolen 11 Aug).

waypoints.name: Quito (northern side; pick-up point), Ecuador
waypoints.event: Driven ~20 km to San Antonio (offroute) on 23 Jul; later walked the stretch from the pick-up point without equipment (date late Aug, not given).

waypoints.name: San Antonio / Mitad del Mundo, Ecuador
waypoints.event: Stayed with Imbaquingo family 23 Jul-31 Aug; left from equator monument 31 Aug.

waypoints.name: Tulcan, Ecuador
waypoints.event: 'At last I made it back onto the Pan-American'.

waypoints.name: Ecuador -> Colombia border bridge (unnamed in journal; Rumichaca by inference)
waypoints.event: Walked over without stamps ('without a question being asked'); then Ipiales.

waypoints.name: Pasto, Colombia
waypoints.event: Rest 12-18 Sep.

waypoints.name: El Bordo, Colombia
waypoints.event: ELN roadblock reported nearby.

waypoints.name: Santander de Quilichao, Colombia
waypoints.event: Walked with an army patrol 30 Sep-1 Oct.

waypoints.name: Cali, Colombia
waypoints.event: 'Total distance to date : 5,680 miles approx.' Stay to 16 Oct (offroute stay at Galia's house above city); resumed from city centre 16 Oct.

waypoints.name: Medellin, Colombia
waypoints.event: Arrived 1 Nov 2000 (2nd anniversary). ~2.5-month pause planning the Darien route, waiting for dry season and money. Departed 14 Jan 2001 on the road to Turbo, disguised as a vagrant (grid of 14 Jan entry).

waypoints.name: Santa Fe de Antioquia (Rio Cauca crossing), Colombia
Canasgordas, Colombia
waypoints.event: Held briefly by AUC paramilitaries, released.

waypoints.name: Dabeiba, Colombia
waypoints.event: Questioned by FARC unit north of Dabeiba on 22 Jan (grid 07°06'N 76°24'W).

waypoints.name: El Tigre (left main Medellin-Turbo road), Colombia
'Casa 40' track dead end (~40 km from El Tigre), Colombia
waypoints.event: Track did not reach the Rio Atrato; next day rode back in an AUC pick-up over ground already walked (offroute backtrack). Coordinates rough.

waypoints.name: Belen de Bajira army post, Colombia
waypoints.event: Signed statement acknowledging danger.

waypoints.name: Night 28 Jan 2001 on Bajira-Riosucio track (journal grid)
waypoints.event: 20+ armed men passed close in the night ('this could be my last letter home').

waypoints.name: Riosucio army post, Colombia
waypoints.event: Rest 30-31 Jan.

waypoints.name: Rio Atrato, floating/swimming downstream (journal grid 1 Feb)
waypoints.event: Entered the river hidden among debris; ~32 miles in the river per home team.

waypoints.name: Travesia ('Travisa'), left the Atrato (journal grid 4 Feb)
waypoints.event: Refused boat lifts ('I can't take a boat').

waypoints.name: Jungle/hills west of Atrato near Cristales/Bijao (journal grid 11 Feb)
waypoints.event: Cross-country, no track, 5-11 Feb.

waypoints.name: Colombia -> Panama border ridge near Palo de las Letras (journal grid 12 Feb)
waypoints.event: Reached ridgeline and found a track, '300 metres from where I've marked the village of Palo de Letras'. Exact moment of crossing the line not stated (12 or 13 Feb). No Colombian exit stamp.

waypoints.name: Paya, Panama
waypoints.event: First Panamanian village; "Welcome to Panama, welcome to Central America and welcome to 'Stage Three'."

waypoints.name: Boca de Cupe, Panama
waypoints.event: Detained by Panamanian police (no visa / no exit stamp). Held here to 20 Feb, then moved offroute (helicopter forced landing at Yaviza, truck to Meteti cells 20-23 Feb, boat to La Palma prison 23 Feb-5 Mar). 18 days custody. Returned to Boca de Cupe 7 Mar; restarted 8 Mar with officer's signature as proof.

waypoints.name: Meteti police cells (custody, offroute)
waypoints.event: Custody 20-23 Feb; Karl: 'I was far better off in Meteti.'

waypoints.name: La Palma prison (custody, offroute)
waypoints.event: Custody 23 Feb-5 Mar; released to walk on and collect visa in Panama City.

waypoints.name: Meteti (walking), Panama
waypoints.event: 'it was about 13:30 when I reached Meteti again'. Grid is the journal's night position.

waypoints.name: Panama City (British Embassy), Panama
waypoints.event: Arrived 16 Mar ('6,671 miles from his starting point' - home team). Pause to 4 Apr (no money, depression; resupply at embassy).

waypoints.name: Bridge of the Americas, Panama
waypoints.event: Resumed walking west.

waypoints.name: David, Panama
waypoints.event: Short stop ~18-24 Apr.

waypoints.name: Few km short of Costa Rica border (journal grid 25 Apr) - end of Leg 01 data
waypoints.event: 'Tonight I stopped just a few K's from the border with Costa Rica.' Border crossing itself belongs to leg 02 (Costa Rica journals not examined here).

pauses.reason: funding (money problems), Christmas/New Year; paid modelling jobs
pauses.left_how: none during stay; left by walking then truck lift (see segment)

claims.value: Journal: first move of ~20 yards on the night of 31 Oct/1 Nov ending in wheel failure; repairs 1 Nov; 'finally underway at 10:36' on Monday 2 Nov 1998

conflicts.assessment: Not truly contradictory: 1 Nov 1998 is the official start ('Day one'), but the first sustained walking day was 2 Nov 1998. Map should use 1 Nov for the start event and note 2 Nov as first walking day.

conflicts.topic: Where the 18 days of Panama detention were served

claims.value: 'he spent 18 days in a jail in Meteti'
Held at Boca de Cupe 16-20 Feb, Meteti cells 20-23 Feb, La Palma prison 23 Feb-5 Mar 2001
Boca de Cupe until 20 Feb, then Meteti, 18 days total in police custody, released via La Palma immigration

conflicts.assessment: Primary sources agree on 18 days but spread over three places; most of it at La Palma. Wikipedia's 'jail in Meteti' is a simplification. Wikipedia cites Giant Steps (S32), which we could not read.

claims.value: Route 'through Argentina, Peru, Ecuador, and Colombia' (Chile omitted)
Chile journals 12 Mar-15 Nov 1999 (Osorno to Arica) plus Punta Arenas region Nov 1998

conflicts.assessment: Wikipedia omits Chile; journals show ~8 months walking the length of Chile. Use journals.

claims.value: 6,671 miles from Punta Arenas on arrival 16 Mar 2001

conflicts.assessment: Single source only; not independently confirmed. Journal running totals: ~1370 mi Osorno, 2740 mi Antofagasta, 3080 mi Iquique, 5010 mi Cuenca, 5,680 mi Cali.

claims.value: '70 minutes 23 degrees west, 23 degrees 50 minutes south' after leaving Antofagasta northbound

conflicts.assessment: 23°50'S is south of Antofagasta (23°39'S) while the Tropic is 23°26'S north of the city; the grid is garbled. Kept as reported but flagged.

claims.value: 3 Jun 2000 '70 degrees 50 minutes west' at Peru/Ecuador river

conflicts.assessment: Evident typing slips; 21 Dec omitted, others kept/flagged or replaced with approximate_region.

unknowns: Names of border posts: Chile->Argentina (Nov 1998), Argentina->Chile pass (Mar 1999), Chile->Peru (Nov 1999), Ecuador->Colombia bridge (Sep 2000) are not named in the journals; identifications (Monte Aymond, Cardenal Samore, Chacalluta/Santa Rosa, Rumichaca) are inference only.

Road numbers for Punta Arenas->border, Rio Gallegos->Piedra Buena, Piedra Buena->Gobernador Gregores, Tecka->Esquel, El Bolson->Chile pass, Antofagasta->Iquique coastal stretch, Loja->Quito are not given in sources.
Exact location of the junction where Karl left the main road for Esquel (Feb 1999).
Antofagasta departure date and route 31 Aug-14 Sep 1999 (journal pages missing; Chile p.12 archived copy duplicates p.9).
Whether the Jan 2000 truck drop-off near Arequipa was the same Pan-American junction he left on 1 Dec 1999 (possible un-walked gap).
Whether after the 1-3 May 1999 farm visit (Chile) and the Arica trips (Nov 1999) he resumed at the exact same point (no explicit statement; cart stayed in Arica).
Date of the Loja->Macara visa trip and of the Quito->San Antonio make-up walk (2000).
Exact moment of crossing the Colombia-Panama line (12 or 13 Feb 2001).
Fate of the trailer 'the beast' after May 2000 (switched to donkey/horse, then backpack with kit sent ahead by bus).
Book 'Giant Steps' (2006) not consulted - full text access-restricted on Internet Archive; may contain corrections to journal details.
No trip to the UK found in this leg; whether Karl left South America at all 1998-2001 is not stated in any source seen (none found).
